description: This file defines an immutable implementation of the ReplyTarget interface, including JSON serialization/deserialization, a builder, and associated data fields such as address, headerMapping, and expectedResponseTypes.

classes.name: ImmutableReplyTarget
classes.description: Immutable implementation of the ReplyTarget interface, encapsulating address, optional headerMapping, and expected response types with JSON serialization support.

classes.name: ImmutableReplyTarget.Builder
classes.description: Builder class for constructing instances of ImmutableReplyTarget, providing methods to set address, headerMapping, and expectedResponseTypes.

methods.name: getAddress
methods.description: Returns the address associated with this reply target.

methods.name: getHeaderMapping
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the header mapping if present.

methods.name: getExpectedResponseTypes
methods.description: Returns the set of expected response types for this reply target.

methods.name: toBuilder
methods.description: Creates a new Builder initialized with current values.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Serializes this reply target to a JsonObject based on the provided schema version and predicate.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates a ReplyTarget instance from the provided JSON object; throws if required fields are missing.

methods.name: fromJsonOptional
methods.description: Optionally creates a ReplyTarget based on JSON content if present.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality between this object and another.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Generates hash code based on address, headerMapping, and expectedResponseTypes.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the object.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds and returns the ImmutableReplyTarget instance.
